mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS ( -- 递归生成指定日期范围内的所有日期 SELECT DATE(#{startTime}) AS date UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(date, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM date_series WHERE date <= #{endTime}-- 修改结束日期为 2025-02-21 ), device_list AS ( -- 获取特定设备 ID（过滤设备） SELECT DISTINCT factory_device_id FROM grade_history WHERE factory_device_id = #{factoryDeviceId} ) SELECT d.factory_device_id, ds.date as tm, COALESCE(MAX(g.grade), 0) AS grade FROM date_series ds CROSS JOIN device_list d LEFT JOIN grade_history g ON ds.date = DATE(g.tm) AND d.factory_device_id = g.factory_device_id GROUP BY d.factory_device_id, ds.date ORDER BY ds.date, d.factory_device_id;
